trend.sma200_up: 200-day SMA uptrend (daily, hold when price > SMA)
trend.sma200_down: 200-day SMA downtrend (daily, hold when price < SMA)
trend.sma10m_up: 10-month SMA uptrend (monthly trading, hold when month-end price > SMA)
trend.sma10m_down: 10-month SMA downtrend (monthly trading, hold when month-end price < SMA)

notes: All stats (CAGR, Vol, Sharpe, MaxDD) are computed on daily returns. Monthly series is stored only for client-side charting and is NOT used for the summary statistics.

Non-reinvest mechanic: when a filter masks a position, that slice of capital earns the BIL cash rate (post-2007-05-30) or a synthetic level built from FRED TB3MS (pre-2007). TB3MS annualized rate is compounded at (1+r)^(1/252)-1 per business day; the synthetic level is spliced to BIL at its first observation so there is no return jump at the seam.
Momentum filters (standard 12mo, fmom 12/8, fmom 12/12) are sampled at the quarterly CAPE rebal date and held until the next rebal. Trend filter is applied daily.

Top/bottom contributor is determined per (CAPE basket, trend, momentum) combination by ranking each country's cumulative arithmetic contribution to the strategy's gross long return over the full live period (sum_t weight_c * country_ret). Uses look-ahead -- robustness toggle, not a tradable signal.
Rolling 5-yr metrics use calendar-year anchors (e.g. anchor 2002 = window 1998-01-01 through 2002-12-31).
